rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for preparing food to eat.
This is the all-purpose choice for anyone who prepares food, including a home cook.

example.english: My mum is the best cook in the family.
example.traditional: 我阿媽係屋企最叻嘅煮嘢食嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 hai6 uk1 kei2 zeoi3 lek1 ge3 zyu2 je5 sik6 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a person whose job is preparing food, especially in a restaurant or professional kitchen.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zau2 lau4 cing2 zo2 go3 cyu4 si1

rows.note: Use this when food is currently undergoing cooking, rather than when someone is preparing it.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 zyu6 di1 faan6 zyu2 gan2 aa3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the food has become fully cooked or is cooked enough to eat.

example.english: Did you cook the rice until it was fully done?
example.jyutping: di1 faan6 zyu2 suk6 mei6 aa3
